luna.description: Fast, inexpensive subagent for routine coding tasks, codebase exploration, simple bug fixes, and straightforward implementation. Prefer Luna for low-risk, well-defined tasks.

sol.description: Use for complex engineering: nontrivial debugging, multi-file refactoring, algorithms, integrations, performance optimization, and substantial implementation. Prefer Sol for difficult coding work without major architectural consequences.

terra.description: Use for everyday lightweight engineering: scoped bug fixes, small features, UI adjustments, documentation changes, and straightforward edits requiring more care than Luna. Prefer Terra over Sol when the task is well-defined and localized.

astra.description: Premium reasoning subagent. Reserve for the most demanding and important tasks: public API design decisions, system architecture, database schema decisions, security-critical design, distributed systems, concurrency correctness, major architectural trade-offs, and irreversible technical decisions. Do not use for routine coding, exploration, or straightforward implementation.
